pois.name: South Polar Vortex
pois.summary: Warm cyclonic vortex over Neptune’s south polar region, with an edge often near roughly 80°S in atmospheric observations. This is a persistent atmospheric feature, distinct from the transient Great Dark Spot imaged by Voyager 2 near ~20°S.

sources.name: Reviews of Geophysics — Polar vortices in planetary atmospheres
